answer: Make every identity climb its own summit: a newcomer must lock a reputation bond in escrow that only unlocks after months of verified good work, and the bond doubles for each extra identity funded from the same source — the tenth fake costs 512 times the first. The bond is backed by an external credential a farm cannot mint itself, like a verified real-world attestation. A gale of clones then drowns in its own escrow: each clone's river of locked funds grows until cloning stops paying.
